Question: aajkal Video bananay ka daur chal raha hai aur har ek ke paas takreeban Mobile Camera hai aur iis-say movie banayi jaati hai aur doosron ko dikhayi bhi jaati hai photo's bhi nikalay jaatay hein.Sirf Mobile ke jariye movie ya photo nikalna kaisa hai agar movie nikalna jayez hai t-o kya marriage ceremony mein movie bana saktay hein iis ehtiyat ke sath ke mard mard ki movie banaye aur sirf mard hi dekhein aurat....aurat kei movie banayein aur sirf aurat hi dekhein sirf movie ho background mein koii bhi music na ho t-o kya iis tarah se kar saktay hein. Answer ID: 9585 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2308/2104=D/1429) Making film and taking photograph is unlawful. It is mentioned in Hadith: اشد الناس عذابا المصورون (On the Day of Judgment, picture-makers will be given the severest punishment. Whether it is made from camera or mobile, whether in a party or not, whether of mixed gathering or not, all carry the same ruling. Making films of men and women separately is also unlawful and haram , while making the film of men and women together is more sinful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
